nodes.label: Expert Craftsmanship

nodes.label: Systematic Patterns

nodes.label: Accessibility (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: CRITICAL priority. Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text (3:1 large text); visible focus rings (2-4px); descriptive alt text; aria-label for icon-only buttons; keyboard nav matching visual order; skip links; sequential heading hierarchy h1-h6; don't convey info by color alone; respect prefers-reduced-motion; WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA criteria (focus-not-obscured, focus-appearance, dragging-alternative, web-target-size, consistent-help, redundant-entry, accessible-authentication, auto-rotation-controls, contextual-live-badge-updates).

nodes.label: Touch & Interaction (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: CRITICAL priority. Min touch target 44x44pt (Apple) / 48x48dp (Material); 8px+ gap between touch targets; click/tap over hover; loading buttons with spinner; error feedback near problem; touch-action manipulation; platform standard gestures; haptic feedback; safe-area awareness; no pixel-perfect taps.

nodes.label: Performance (HIGH)
nodes.rationale: HIGH priority. WebP/AVIF, lazy loading, reserve space (CLS < 0.1); font-display swap/optional; critical CSS; lazy load non-hero components; bundle splitting by route/feature; third-party scripts async/defer; virtualize lists 50+ items; main-thread budget ~16ms for 60fps; skeleton screens; input latency <100ms; debounce/throttle; offline support.

nodes.label: Style Selection (HIGH)
nodes.rationale: HIGH priority. Match style to product type; consistency across pages; SVG icons not emoji; palette from product/industry; effects aligned with style; platform-adaptive idioms (iOS HIG vs Material); state clarity; consistent elevation/shadow scale; dark mode pairing; one icon set/visual language; native/system controls; blur for background dismissal; one primary CTA per screen.

nodes.label: Layout & Responsive (HIGH)
nodes.rationale: HIGH priority. viewport meta width=device-width initial-scale=1; mobile-first; systematic breakpoints (375/768/1024/1440); min 16px body text; line length 35-60 mobile / 60-75 desktop; no horizontal scroll; 4pt/8dp spacing system; consistent max-width desktop; z-index scale; viewport units min-h-dvh; visual hierarchy via size/spacing/contrast.

nodes.label: Typography & Color (MEDIUM)
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM priority. Line-height 1.5-1.75; line length 65-75 chars; font pairing; consistent type scale; darker text on light backgrounds; semantic color tokens (primary, secondary, error, surface, on-surface) not raw hex; dark mode desaturated/lighter tonal variants; 4.5:1 AA / 7:1 AAA contrast pairs; functional color needs icon/text; tabular figures for data columns.

nodes.label: Animation (MEDIUM)
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM priority. Shared motion tokens by distance/complexity; transform/opacity only; animate 1-2 key elements per view; deceleration arriving / acceleration leaving; motion must express cause-effect; smooth state transitions; spatial continuity; spring/physics curves; exit faster than enter (~60-70%); stagger 30-50ms; shared element transitions; interruptible; no blocking input; crossfade content replacement.

nodes.label: Forms & Feedback (MEDIUM)
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM priority. Visible labels per input; error below field with aria-describedby; loading then success/error on submit; required indicators; empty states; toast auto-dismiss 3-5s; confirm destructive actions; helper text; disabled reduced opacity 0.38-0.5; progressive disclosure; validate on blur; semantic input types; password toggle; autocomplete; undo support; success feedback; error recovery cause+fix; multi-step progress; form autosave; focus management; error summary.

nodes.label: Navigation Patterns (HIGH)
nodes.rationale: HIGH priority. Bottom nav max 5 items with labels; drawer for secondary nav; predictable back behavior; deep linking; iOS bottom Tab Bar; Android Top App Bar; icon+label nav items; current location highlighted; primary vs secondary nav separated; modal close affordance; search reachable; breadcrumbs 3+ level; state preservation; system gesture support; badges sparingly; overflow menu; bottom nav top-level only; sidebar large screens; no stack reset; navigation consistency; no mixed patterns; modals not for primary navigation; focus on route change; persistent nav; destructive nav separation; empty nav state.

nodes.label: Charts & Data (LOW)
nodes.rationale: LOW priority. Match chart type to data; accessible palettes no red/green only; table alternative; patterns/textures supplement color; visible legend; tooltips on interact; axis labels with units; responsive chart; empty data state; skeleton loading; animation respects reduced-motion; aggregate/sample 1000+ points; locale-aware formatting; >=44pt tap area; no pie >5 categories; >=3:1 data vs background, >=4.5:1 data text; clickable legends; direct labeling; keyboard-reachable tooltips; sortable tables; subtle gridlines; limit data density; emphasize trends; focusable chart elements; screen-reader summary; error state with retry; CSV/image export; drill-down back path; time scale clarity.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Token Architecture
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Primitive (raw values) → Semantic (purpose aliases) → Component (component-specific) layers enable theme switching via the semantic layer and per-component customization via component tokens; raw hex values are prohibited in components.

nodes.label: Primitive Tokens
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Raw token values, e.g. --color-blue-600: #2563EB; base layer of the three-layer token architecture.

nodes.label: Semantic Tokens
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Purpose aliases that reference primitives, e.g. --color-primary: var(--color-blue-600); enables light/dark theme switching.

nodes.label: Component Tokens
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Component-specific token values, e.g. --button-bg: var(--color-primary); enables per-component customization.

nodes.label: CSS Variable System
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Design tokens exposed as CSS variables (var(--color-primary), var(--slide-bg), var(--typography-font-heading)); single source of truth imported by slides.

nodes.label: Component Spec Pattern
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Component property spec across Background, Text, Border, Shadow for Default, Hover, Active, Disabled states.

nodes.label: Slide System
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Brand-compliant presentations using design tokens, Chart.js, and a contextual decision system; all slides must import design-tokens.css and use var() exclusively.

nodes.label: Chart.js Integration
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Charts must use Chart.js (not CSS-only bars); slide HTML loads chart.js@4.4.1 from jsDelivr and renders canvas datasets with token-branded colors.

nodes.author: claudekit

nodes.rationale: Visual design philosophy, systematic composition, and sophisticated visual communication; two-phase process: design philosophy creation then visual expression

nodes.label: Design Philosophy Creation
nodes.rationale: Phase 1: aesthetic movement expressed through form, space, color, composition; 4-6 paragraph design manifesto covering space/form, color/material, scale/rhythm, composition/balance, visual hierarchy

nodes.label: Visual Expression
nodes.rationale: Phase 2: express philosophy through canvas artifacts - 90% visual design, 10% essential text, museum-quality execution, systematic patterns, sophisticated composition

nodes.label: Core Principles
nodes.rationale: Visual communication first, minimal text integration, expert craftsmanship, systematic patterns

nodes.label: Design Movements
nodes.rationale: Concrete poetry (monumental form, bold geometry), chromatic language (color as primary information), analog meditation (texture, negative space), organic systems (modular growth), geometric silence (order, restraint)

nodes.label: OKLCH Color System
nodes.rationale: Limited palette (2-5 colors), cohesive system, purposeful relationships, oklch color space for precision, each shade carries meaning

nodes.label: Canvas Output Format
nodes.rationale: Required files: design philosophy (.md) and visual expression (.pdf or .png), high resolution, clean margins

nodes.label: shadcn/ui Accessibility Patterns
nodes.rationale: ARIA patterns, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and accessible component usage

nodes.label: Radix UI Primitives
nodes.rationale: Foundation: unstyled, accessible components following WAI-ARIA design patterns; built-in keyboard navigation, screen reader announcements, focus management, ARIA attributes automatically applied

nodes.label: Keyboard Navigation
nodes.rationale: Focus visible states, skip to content, dialog focus trap (Esc closes, Tab cycles, focus returns to trigger), dropdown arrow navigation, command palette type-to-filter

nodes.label: Screen Reader Support
nodes.rationale: Semantic HTML, ARIA labels, sr-only screen reader text, live regions (polite/assertive), toast live region announced automatically

nodes.label: Form Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Labels and descriptions, error handling with aria-invalid/aria-describedby, required fields, fieldset and legend grouping

nodes.label: WCAG Color Contrast
nodes.rationale: AA: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text; AAA: 7:1 normal, 4.5:1 large; use semantic muted foreground

nodes.label: Focus Indicators
nodes.rationale: Visible focus rings with focus-visible, custom focus styles, never remove focus styles with focus:outline-none

nodes.label: Reduced Motion
nodes.rationale: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce via CSS animation/transition overrides and motion-reduce:transition-none classes

nodes.label: Accessibility Testing
nodes.rationale: Checklist: keyboard accessible, focus visible, screen reader announcements, WCAG AA contrast, semantic HTML, ARIA labels, dialog focus trap, dropdown keyboard, live regions, reduced motion, 200% zoom, logical tab order, skip links; tools: Lighthouse, axe DevTools, NVDA/JAWS

nodes.label: Accessibility rules (Priority 1, CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: CRITICAL priority because inaccessible UI excludes users and fails WCAG 2.2 audits; covers contrast 4.5:1, alt text, keyboard nav, ARIA labels, focus rings, and reduced motion.

nodes.label: Touch & Interaction rules (Priority 2, CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: CRITICAL priority touch target minimums (44x44pt iOS, 48x48dp Android), 8px+ spacing, tap feedback, and gesture conflict prevention.

nodes.label: Performance rules (Priority 3, HIGH)
nodes.rationale: HIGH priority web performance rules: image optimization, font loading, critical CSS, lazy loading, bundle splitting, CLS prevention, and main-thread budget.

nodes.label: Style Selection rules (Priority 4, HIGH)
nodes.rationale: HIGH priority style guidance: match style to product type, SVG icons over emoji, consistent icon sets, platform-adaptive idioms, dark-mode pairing, and single primary CTA per screen.

nodes.label: Layout & Responsive rules (Priority 5, HIGH)
nodes.rationale: HIGH priority layout rules: mobile-first breakpoints, viewport meta, 4pt/8dp spacing scale, container max-width, z-index management, and orientation support.

nodes.label: Typography & Color rules (Priority 6, MEDIUM)
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM priority visual fundamentals: 1.5-1.75 line height, semantic color tokens, 4.5:1/7:1 contrast pairs, type scales, tabular figures, and truncation strategy.

nodes.label: Animation rules (Priority 7, MEDIUM)
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM priority motion guidance: transform/opacity-only animation, spring physics, reduced-motion respect, shared motion tokens, and exit-faster-than-enter timing.

nodes.label: Forms & Feedback rules (Priority 8, MEDIUM)
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM priority form UX: visible labels, inline validation on blur, error recovery paths, aria-live errors, toast accessibility, and multi-step progress.

nodes.label: Navigation Patterns rules (Priority 9, HIGH)
nodes.rationale: HIGH priority navigation guidance: bottom nav max 5 items, predictable back behavior, deep linking, drawer/sidebar separation, and consistent nav placement across pages.

nodes.label: Charts & Data rules (Priority 10, LOW)
nodes.rationale: LOW priority data visualization rules: chart type matching, accessible palettes, table alternatives, legends, tooltips, responsive charts, and drill-down consistency.

nodes.label: Nova Terminal
nodes.rationale: Professional trading analysis terminal. PySide6/Qt desktop. Dark theme only. Indian market focus. Analysis-only — no execution, no orders.

nodes.label: Design Principles
nodes.rationale: Every pixel shows actionable data; key numbers readable in <1 second; color carries meaning; monospace numbers prevent layout shift; missing/stale data shown as dash/N/A never fabricated.

nodes.label: Layout Architecture
nodes.rationale: Command bar (44px), sidebar (56px), ticker strip (30px), page content (QStackedWidget), status bar (26px).

nodes.label: Color System
nodes.rationale: All colors from styles/design_tokens.py; never hardcode hex. Directional GREEN/RED, warning AMBER, active CYAN; freshness tiers FRESH/STALE/CRITICAL.

nodes.label: Typography System
nodes.rationale: Segoe UI for UI text, Consolas for data; monospace prevents layout shift; type scale from CAPTION 8.5px to KPI 28px.

nodes.label: Spacing System
nodes.rationale: 8dp grid; SPACE_XS 4px to SPACE_XXL 32px; border radius SM 4px to LG 12px.

nodes.label: Component Patterns
nodes.rationale: Panel/section card, index card (NIFTY/BANKNIFTY), breadth bar, key-value row, button variants (Default/Primary/Danger/Disabled).

nodes.label: Page Layout Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Market Overview, Stock Analysis, Institutional Flows, Market Lab, Nova AI tab layouts with defined card and column structure.

nodes.label: Interaction Patterns
nodes.rationale: Sidebar instant tab switch; _DataWorker(QThread) async pattern; refresh disabled during load; keyboard navigation with Enter search and /ai command.

nodes.label: Data Display Rules
nodes.rationale: INR price ₹{:,.2f}, percentage {:.2f}%, crore ₹{:.2f}Cr; missing numeric shows em dash, text shows N/A, never 0 or fabricated; freshness badge always visible.

nodes.label: Chart Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Candlestick GREEN/RED bodies, volume at 40% opacity, max 500 candles, sparklines 90px height, breadth bar 32px with proportional segments.

nodes.label: Status & Health Indicators
nodes.rationale: Service dots (green/responding, red/down, muted/initializing), NSE market status OPEN/CLOSED, regime badge with dynamic border color.

nodes.label: Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Guardrail text always visible; BUY_SELL_AUTHORIZED = False never changed; no trade execution UI; analytical framing only (signal/regime/bias, never buy/sell/enter).

nodes.label: Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Contrast ~12:1 exceeds 4.5:1 AA; cyan focus rings; keyboard tab order; no color-only meaning; monospace tabular figures; dark theme only.

nodes.label: Analysis-only framing
nodes.rationale: All language is analytical ('signal', 'regime', 'bias'), never instructional ('buy', 'sell', 'enter'); guardrails survive every redesign.

nodes.label: BUY_SELL_AUTHORIZED = False
